work_order.root_cause:
Two causes, one per bug, and only one of them is in the diff this ticket locked.

BUG-1: the bypass guarantee was specified and verified as a document-order property when focus order is a different axis. src/web/client.js:35-40 autofocuses `.panel-error [data-action="retry"]` unconditionally on load, so on every error shell activeElement is already deep in the document before the user has pressed anything, and the first Tab continues from there — the skip link is never the first stop. Nothing in the suite can see it: every guard in test/web/pages.test.js asserts against the rendered HTML string, and this is a runtime script side effect. The load-time focus was also doing a job it cannot do — it stands in for an announcement of the failure that does not exist, and on a region-level failure (?meta_error=) the page state is still 'ideal', so the live region names nothing that failed.

BUG-2: both landmark guards ask for their attribute with \b, which asserts a word boundary, not whitespace. '-' is a non-word character, so \bid="main" matches the tail of data-id="main", and the same is true of \btabindex / \bclass / \bhref in the same helper. A landmark carrying only data-id="main" is not the skip link's target — href="#main" resolves to nothing — and the suite is green under exactly that mutation.
